brief:
A wave of 10 retro talons led by a fanatical ace known as Vera "Crusader" Rostova. Grayson's Centurion is stopped in its tracks. The fanatical ace accuses Grayson of carrying dangerous high level alien technology - "MACHINES OF DAMNABLE INTENT". 
Grayson turns the entire thing into a joke by casually flirting with Vera, only making her more agitated. "VILE HERETIC!! PREPARE TO DIE"
triggers_text: Carrying the Steltek gun through Nitir jump to Blockade Point Tango.
outcome_text: The player must defeat 10 retro talons.
